custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test at a cost of $10.00, with 5 in bin location A and 3 in bin location B, so the report has two bins to add up.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value), with the as-of date on today.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425663-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425663-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • The Inventory Value report: Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value. Its As of: date, Category:, Vendor: and Location: filters sit above the table; Download (PDF) and Download (CSV) are in its three-dot menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 2:

  • Part A is listed with Qty 8.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost $80.00 (5 + 3 = 8; 8 × $10.00 = $80.00), the result the report gave before this fix.
  • The Totals row reads Qty 8.00 and Total Cost $80.00.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; ships with this epic)

  • SV-10380, description, Acceptance criteria: “All-positive quantities retain existing results.”
  • SV-10380, description, Reproduction table: “+5 and +3 | 8 / $80 | 8 / $80”
